Titles.jpn: デジモンアドベンチャーtri.（トライ）第6章「ぼくらの未来」

Summaries.eng: There is a new threat from a mysterious and newly formed Digimon. The DigiDestined must stand together to save their friends and our world. Who knows what the future holds for the DigiDestined, as they prepare for their biggest battle yet.
